LESSON: DANGEROUS CHEMICALS AT HOME

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Safety Education
Topic 4.4: Dangerous chemicals at home

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Dangerous chemicals at home. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Dangerous chemicals at home
2. Practise Dangerous chemicals at home at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Dangerous chemicals at home

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Dangerous chemicals at home
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Dangerous chemicals at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Dangerous chemicals at home at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Dangerous chemicals at home at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Dangerous chemicals at home
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Dangerous chemicals at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Dangerous chemicals at home using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Dangerous chemicals at home in the examples.
2. Explain Dangerous chemicals at home to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Dangerous chemicals at home.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Dangerous chemicals at home using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Dangerous chemicals at home important for a Grade 1 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Learners mention the c) embrace the need to dangers caused by avoid handling dangerous chemicals used at home chemicals used at home
2. Learners listen to stories or to ensure safety. watch a video on dangers caused by dangerous chemicals used at home.
3. Environmental activities Learners to discuss about the hazardous household products with their family

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Dangerous chemicals at home
2. Practise Dangerous chemicals at home at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Dangerous chemicals at home

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
